title: ROAX type map v1
description: Binds record paths to ROAX type tags. This file is the schema FOR the type map; the type map itself does not exist yet (spec section 4.3) and building it is on the critical path. The type map is NORMATIVE data: two libraries carrying different type maps produce different roots for the same record, which is the highest-risk surface in the design (spec section 4). It is versioned with the specification and is part of the conformance corpus (docs/conformance-corpus.md class 11).

typeMapVersion.description: Version of this type map. Changing any entry MUST bump it. A root computed under one type-map version is not reproducible under another if the changed entry was reachable.

recordType.description: The profile this map applies to. Matches the envelope's recordType.

schemaVersion.description: The profile version this map applies to.

sourceSchemas.description: Provenance: which reference schemas this map was derived from, cited by path and commit. The reference schemata live OUTSIDE this repository by design and are never copied in.

entries.description: Path-pattern to type-tag bindings. Order is significant: the FIRST matching entry wins, so more specific patterns MUST precede more general ones.

pattern.description: Path pattern in display notation, where '*' matches any single array index and '**' matches any run of segments. Example: 'fhirBundle.entry[*].resource.valueQuantity.value'. The pattern addresses the STRUCTURED path (spec section 5); the display form is used here only because it is readable, and an implementation MUST match against decoded segments rather than against a rendered string.

jsonKind.description: Restricts this entry to a particular observed JSON kind at that path. Present because polymorphic fields are real and already in the reference records: in the shipped vaccination sample, fhirBundle.entry[0].identifier[0].type is the string "PPN" while identifier[1].type is the object { text: "NRIC" }. A map keyed by path alone cannot express that (spec section 4.2). Omit when the path is monomorphic.

tag.description: ROAX type tag: 0 NULL, 1 BOOL, 2 STRING, 3 INTEGER, 4 DECIMAL, 5 BYTES, 6 EMPTY_ARRAY, 7 EMPTY_OBJECT. Tags 6 and 7 are produced by the flattener for empty containers and are not normally asserted here.

source.description: Where this binding came from, so a reviewer can check it. E.g. the FHIR element declaration that says this element is `decimal`.

$comment: Unknown paths MUST fail closed (spec section 4.2, decision D7 - OPEN). This schema deliberately provides no default-tag or fallback field: a type map that could express 'anything else is a STRING' would let two libraries with different maps silently agree on a wrong root. If decision D7 is ruled the other way, that fallback belongs here and this comment must be removed.
